stories.title: OpenSSH: post-quantum key exchange shipped, deployed, then drifted
stories.blurb: The OpenSSH 10.0p2 product record shows hybrid ML-KEM key exchange on by default and signatures still classical. An operator then configures a bastion to allow only post-quantum key exchange, and a scan a week later finds a classical method back in the list.

stories.title: ExampleGate: post-quantum by software update (fictional)
stories.blurb: One VPN gateway in two releases. In 4.2.0 post-quantum key exchange is promised for the next release. In 4.3.0 it is there, switched on by configuration, but outside the FIPS 140-3 validated boundary. The operator's record then requires it.

stories.title: Remote administration: a system that waits on its CA
stories.blurb: An integrator's design joining the VPN gateway and the SSH bastion. Every interface names what provides its keys, which shows that the enterprise CA and the administrators' security keys hold back post-quantum authentication for the whole design.

stories.title: Keycloak: one product at every stage
stories.blurb: The methodology's main worked example. The same identity server as built, as intended, as configured, as observed, and as a managed service, with the database at the far end of one connection.

stories.title: Substation automation
stories.blurb: A protection IED, the IEC 60870-5-104 library a gateway embeds, and the substation system an integrator delivers from them.

stories.title: Soil sensors
stories.blurb: Two field sensors. One can never be updated; the other can.

stories.title: Hardware security modules
stories.blurb: A payment HSM written against the draft HSM profiles, and a real HSM described from its public documentation.

stories.title: Managed payment cryptography
stories.blurb: A managed payment HSM service, described from its public documentation.

stories.title: 5G roaming interconnect
stories.blurb: A SEPP network function as a product and as deployed, and the roaming interconnect a service assurance record describes.
